_comment: Edge voice notes. Buyers are health-system operators reading LinkedIn between meetings. Lead with operational specifics, not vendor pitches.
shared_voice_notes: Lead with the operational pattern, not the technology. Cite a specific lever (FTE count, denial rate, hire-to-fill cycle).
Treat hospitals as the customer, never as a vendor or 'staffing problem'.
When citing data, name the cohort (urban academic medical center, rural FQHC, community hospital under 200 beds, etc.) so the reader sees themselves in it.
